name: St George

crownPassive.text: Blocks the first 5 damage of the first attack on any of your heroes each round.

bond.text: When one of your Beast heroes dies, his Guard is added to his Attack. If one of your Healers dies, his Attack doubles.

actions.name: Attack
actions.text: Standard attack: damage equal to Attack.

actions.name: Shield Brother
actions.text: An adjacent hero takes no damage this round.

notes: Actions come from the design-system card mock-up, not yet confirmed in the design doc.
